answer: Bind each agent to a refundable stake whose kernel is one funded identity: weight unlocks only slowly as independent peers attest to honest work across many epochs. A fresh account begins as a blank opal of near-zero trust; standing hardens like jade only through a long verified record. A clone fleet must sink a separate bond and serve its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly instead of letting one operator cheaply mint a swarm of names.
